answer: An operator running 297 keys thus burns for 297 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the lagoon quota and the lantern admission check. Challenge issue is rate limited to 3 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole fleet at once. Since the throttle counters live in the glacier ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
